b59a3c9ee377d49e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Cost Planning to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery of Qiddiya’s cost planning requirements within assigned business units, development projects, and governance activities. The Senior Manager will provide structured cost planning support, coordinate consultants, offer input for Stage Gate reviews, conduct benchmarking analysis, and assist with cost governance to ensure project budgets, cost plans, and design-to-budget decisions are evidence-based, consistent, and aligned with Qiddiya’s standards. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to support General Business Unit Cost Planning in applying consistent cost planning standards across Qiddiya’s business units and development assets. The Senior Manager will operate within the Business Unit cost planning environment, supporting the application of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, cost planning processes, benchmarking requirements, and digital tools. While external cost consultants or project teams may prepare detailed cost plans, this role is responsible for reviewing assigned outputs, coordinating comments, maintaining cost planning records, and escalating key issues to leadership for review and decision-making. Key Accountabilities Coordinate cost planning activities for assigned projects, workstreams, business unit support activities, and development programmes. Support the implementation of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, templates, trackers, reporting standards, and cost planning governance processes. Review and comment on cost consultant outputs, including cost plans, reconciliations, assumptions, risk allowances, benchmarks, cost reports, and design-to-budget recommendations. Maintain clear and current cost planning records for assigned projects, workstreams, or business unit support areas. Support Stage Gate reviews by checking cost planning readiness, completeness, compliance, and alignment with required deliverables. Coordinate with business units, development teams, design teams, commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital teams, and external consultants to support integrated cost planning outcomes. Support early-stage cost advice, feasibility input, benchmark checks, and pre-concept cost planning where required before the appointment of project cost consultants. Assist with the briefing, mobilisation, coordination, and performance monitoring of executive and project cost consultants. Track scope and cost movements across project phases and escalate material changes, risks, opportunities, and non-compliance issues in a timely and structured manner. Apply benchmarking data, cost planning software, digital tools, and cost planning analytics to support the review and validation of cost positions. Support business unit cost planning capability through training, onboarding, guidance, and adoption of Qiddiya ways of working. Contribute to the preparation of cost planning review packs, governance papers, leadership updates, dashboards, and trackers. Promote consistent ways of working, professional standards, and continuous improvement across the cost planning community. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in cost planning or a related field. Demonstrated ability to interpret cost, design, benchmark, and risk information. Experience in coordinating consultant deliverables and reviewing outputs. Proficiency in applying benchmarking data, cost planning software, and digital tools. Required Attributes Reliable and delivery-focused, with strong ownership of assigned tasks. Professional and constructive in reviewing information, raising issues, and supporting cost planning discussions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data. Clear communicator capable of preparing structured comments, summaries, trackers, and updates. Collaborative and responsive when working with internal stakeholders and external consultants. Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-moving development environment. Committed to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and strengthening cost planning capabilities. Accountability in Relation to Cost Consultants While external cost consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, estimates, benchmarking outputs, risk allowances, cost reports, and supporting analysis, Qiddiya retains accountability for the recommended cost planning position. The Senior Manager supports this accountability by coordinating consultant deliverables, reviewing assigned outputs, recording comments and actions, and escalating key cost planning issues to business unit and cost planning leadership for review. This role ensures that consultant outputs align with Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, reflect approved briefs and design status, include appropriate assumptions and reconciliations, identify risks and opportunities, and provide reliable support for project and governance decisions.
